meta.title: Minor Piece Advance
meta.description: Once lost in frantic confusion, now lucid and moving forward.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Ops Room.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

spans.text: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: Redirect Simo to support Imhotep? ...No, too far, there's not enough time...
units.displayText: Redirect Simo to support Imhotep? ...No, too far, there's not enough time...

spans.text: Redirect Simo to support Imhotep? ...No, too far, there's not enough time...

units.rawText: Rendezvous with Florence? The route's within the crisis zone, far too dangerous.
units.displayText: Rendezvous with Florence? The route's within the crisis zone, far too dangerous.

spans.text: Rendezvous with Florence? The route's within the crisis zone, far too dangerous.

units.rawText: Sorry, Imhotep, really, just give me a moment, a bit more. I'll send someone over immediately. I apologize.
units.displayText: Sorry, Imhotep, really, just give me a moment, a bit more. I'll send someone over immediately. I apologize.

spans.text: Sorry, Imhotep, really, just give me a moment, a bit more. I'll send someone over immediately. I apologize.

units.rawText: Persicaria continues to work away at her command interface, but no real feedback comes.
units.displayText: Persicaria continues to work away at her command interface, but no real feedback comes.

spans.text: Persicaria continues to work away at her command interface, but no real feedback comes.

units.rawText: Persicaria, you...
units.displayText: Persicaria, you...

spans.text: Persicaria, you...

units.rawText: Don't worry. I'm sure there'll be a way. Must... must save everyone...
units.displayText: Don't worry. I'm sure there'll be a way. Must... must save everyone...

spans.text: Don't worry. I'm sure there'll be a way. Must... must save everyone...

units.rawText: We don't have any more reserves, do we? And your neural cloud...
units.displayText: We don't have any more reserves, do we? And your neural cloud...

spans.text: We don't have any more reserves, do we? And your neural cloud...

units.rawText: I'm fine, I'm fine, I can't just watch the Oasis, watch everyone...
units.displayText: I'm fine, I'm fine, I can't just watch the Oasis, watch everyone...

spans.text: I'm fine, I'm fine, I can't just watch the Oasis, watch everyone...

units.rawText: Right, I need to... yes, I'll go to Zone G myself!
units.displayText: Right, I need to... yes, I'll go to Zone G myself!

spans.text: Right, I need to... yes, I'll go to Zone G myself!

units.rawText: Imhotep, hold on, I'm coming!
units.displayText: Imhotep, hold on, I'm coming!

spans.text: Imhotep, hold on, I'm coming!

units.rawText: Persicaria, you're coming to Zone G?
units.displayText: Persicaria, you're coming to Zone G?

spans.text: Persicaria, you're coming to Zone G?

units.rawText: Yeah, my medical capabilities are not lacking, and I can put my command module to better use on the scene!
units.displayText: Yeah, my medical capabilities are not lacking, and I can put my command module to better use on the scene!

spans.text: Yeah, my medical capabilities are not lacking, and I can put my command module to better use on the scene!

units.rawText: No, you're not going to solve a single problem that way! You should stay in the Ops Room and keep an eye on the situation!
units.displayText: No, you're not going to solve a single problem that way! You should stay in the Ops Room and keep an eye on the situation!

spans.text: No, you're not going to solve a single problem that way! You should stay in the Ops Room and keep an eye on the situation!

units.rawText: You were right earlier. We have no more reserves here. I will not accomplish anything by standing here.
units.displayText: You were right earlier. We have no more reserves here. I will not accomplish anything by standing here.

spans.text: You were right earlier. We have no more reserves here. I will not accomplish anything by standing here.

units.rawText: Horizon, prepare the instruments. We're leaving!
units.displayText: Horizon, prepare the instruments. We're leaving!

spans.text: Horizon, prepare the instruments. We're leaving!

units.rawText: Persicaria.
units.displayText: Persicaria.

spans.text: Persicaria.

units.rawText: Operand replenishment gear is here, now for the medical equipment...
units.displayText: Operand replenishment gear is here, now for the medical equipment...

spans.text: Operand replenishment gear is here, now for the medical equipment...

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: Do you have the equipment? Thank you, H...
units.displayText: Do you have the equipment? Thank you, H...

spans.text: Do you have the equipment? Thank you, H...

units.rawText: <size=40>Clap—!</size>
units.displayText: Clap—!

spans.text: Clap—!

units.rawText: Horizon's hands land squarely on Persicaria's cheeks, and she takes the opportunity to squeeze inwards.
units.displayText: Horizon's hands land squarely on Persicaria's cheeks, and she takes the opportunity to squeeze inwards.

spans.text: Horizon's hands land squarely on Persicaria's cheeks, and she takes the opportunity to squeeze inwards.

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: The perfect angle, perfect speed, and perfect point of contact. Yes, executed just as according to standards. Perfectly symmetrical palm marks.
units.displayText: The perfect angle, perfect speed, and perfect point of contact. Yes, executed just as according to standards. Perfectly symmetrical palm marks.

spans.text: The perfect angle, perfect speed, and perfect point of contact. Yes, executed just as according to standards. Perfectly symmetrical palm marks.

units.rawText: Keeping her hands in position, Horizon applies pressure inwards, pressing Persicaria's mouth into an "O" shape, then approaches her, taking a good look at her.
units.displayText: Keeping her hands in position, Horizon applies pressure inwards, pressing Persicaria's mouth into an "O" shape, then approaches her, taking a good look at her.

spans.text: Keeping her hands in position, Horizon applies pressure inwards, pressing Persicaria's mouth into an "O" shape, then approaches her, taking a good look at her.

units.rawText: Target feedback confirmed. Pupils cooled, focus normal.
units.displayText: Target feedback confirmed. Pupils cooled, focus normal.

spans.text: Target feedback confirmed. Pupils cooled, focus normal.

units.rawText: I ought to think you've calmed down, Persicaria. Do you hear me?
units.displayText: I ought to think you've calmed down, Persicaria. Do you hear me?

spans.text: I ought to think you've calmed down, Persicaria. Do you hear me?

units.rawText: ...Yeah.
units.displayText: ...Yeah.

spans.text: ...Yeah.

units.rawText: Welcome back, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Welcome back, Persicaria.

spans.text: Welcome back, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Listen well to Imhotep.
units.displayText: Listen well to Imhotep.

spans.text: Listen well to Imhotep.

units.rawText: Persicaria abruptly looks away from the screen, finding that everyone else in the Ops Room had put down the work at hand to look over at her.
units.displayText: Persicaria abruptly looks away from the screen, finding that everyone else in the Ops Room had put down the work at hand to look over at her.

spans.text: Persicaria abruptly looks away from the screen, finding that everyone else in the Ops Room had put down the work at hand to look over at her.

units.rawText: Then, she looks back toward the figure on the screen.
units.displayText: Then, she looks back toward the figure on the screen.

spans.text: Then, she looks back toward the figure on the screen.

units.rawText: Imhotep takes a deep breath in the video feed. When her eyes open once more, the worry in them had long dissipated.
units.displayText: Imhotep takes a deep breath in the video feed. When her eyes open once more, the worry in them had long dissipated.

spans.text: Imhotep takes a deep breath in the video feed. When her eyes open once more, the worry in them had long dissipated.

units.rawText: You're finally looking at me, Persicaria.
units.displayText: You're finally looking at me, Persicaria.

spans.text: You're finally looking at me, Persicaria.

units.rawText: It was my oversight to allow you to remain in an abnormal state. The first thing one must do with a cat that's gotten all waterlogged is calm their emotions.
units.displayText: It was my oversight to allow you to remain in an abnormal state. The first thing one must do with a cat that's gotten all waterlogged is calm their emotions.

spans.text: It was my oversight to allow you to remain in an abnormal state. The first thing one must do with a cat that's gotten all waterlogged is calm their emotions.

units.rawText: Sorry, Imhotep, I...
units.displayText: Sorry, Imhotep, I...

spans.text: Sorry, Imhotep, I...

units.rawText: I understand. You have no resources to spare for us here, do you?
units.displayText: I understand. You have no resources to spare for us here, do you?

spans.text: I understand. You have no resources to spare for us here, do you?

units.rawText: Yeah, whether it's manpower or route availability. I've tried every remaining possibility, but as it is, there's no more space for me to work with in Zone G.
units.displayText: Yeah, whether it's manpower or route availability. I've tried every remaining possibility, but as it is, there's no more space for me to work with in Zone G.

spans.text: Yeah, whether it's manpower or route availability. I've tried every remaining possibility, but as it is, there's no more space for me to work with in Zone G.

units.rawText: I was serious about making it over there myself. If I head over, we should still be able to spare one squad.
units.displayText: I was serious about making it over there myself. If I head over, we should still be able to spare one squad.

spans.text: I was serious about making it over there myself. If I head over, we should still be able to spare one squad.

units.rawText: Horizon, I'll leave the Ops Room to you. For now, I'm going to...
units.displayText: Horizon, I'll leave the Ops Room to you. For now, I'm going to...

spans.text: Horizon, I'll leave the Ops Room to you. For now, I'm going to...

units.rawText: Calm down. The Ops Room still has more need of you. You don't need to shoulder everything yourself.
units.displayText: Calm down. The Ops Room still has more need of you. You don't need to shoulder everything yourself.

spans.text: Calm down. The Ops Room still has more need of you. You don't need to shoulder everything yourself.

units.rawText: There's no lack of people by your side who will share your burden, and it's not like I'm entirely out of options over here.
units.displayText: There's no lack of people by your side who will share your burden, and it's not like I'm entirely out of options over here.

spans.text: There's no lack of people by your side who will share your burden, and it's not like I'm entirely out of options over here.

units.rawText: Persicaria, you should know where you stand right now, right?
units.displayText: Persicaria, you should know where you stand right now, right?

spans.text: Persicaria, you should know where you stand right now, right?

units.rawText: Eyes still on Imhotep, Persicaria takes a deep breath, then slowly exhales, gradually calming herself down.
units.displayText: Eyes still on Imhotep, Persicaria takes a deep breath, then slowly exhales, gradually calming herself down.

spans.text: Eyes still on Imhotep, Persicaria takes a deep breath, then slowly exhales, gradually calming herself down.

units.rawText: Horizon, sync all personnel in the area Imhotep is in with the network. Get the Ops Room direct control.
units.displayText: Horizon, sync all personnel in the area Imhotep is in with the network. Get the Ops Room direct control.

spans.text: Horizon, sync all personnel in the area Imhotep is in with the network. Get the Ops Room direct control.

units.rawText: Received.
units.displayText: Received.

spans.text: Received.

units.rawText: Imhotep, send whatever coordinates you can to Horizon. She'll provide you with support based on the available intel.
units.displayText: Imhotep, send whatever coordinates you can to Horizon. She'll provide you with support based on the available intel.

spans.text: Imhotep, send whatever coordinates you can to Horizon. She'll provide you with support based on the available intel.

units.rawText: Sorry, this is all I can do. You'll have to manage the rest yourself.
units.displayText: Sorry, this is all I can do. You'll have to manage the rest yourself.

spans.text: Sorry, this is all I can do. You'll have to manage the rest yourself.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: See, there's our good kitty Persicaria!
units.displayText: See, there's our good kitty Persicaria!

spans.text: See, there's our good kitty Persicaria!

units.rawText: Uhh, you were calling me kitty before as well... could I ask why?
units.displayText: Uhh, you were calling me kitty before as well... could I ask why?

spans.text: Uhh, you were calling me kitty before as well... could I ask why?

units.rawText: Hahaha, just a sudden thought. I'll explain next time we talk!
units.displayText: Hahaha, just a sudden thought. I'll explain next time we talk!

spans.text: Hahaha, just a sudden thought. I'll explain next time we talk!

units.rawText: Will do. I'll treat you to coffee when you get back.
units.displayText: Will do. I'll treat you to coffee when you get back.

spans.text: Will do. I'll treat you to coffee when you get back.

units.rawText: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.
units.displayText: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.

spans.text: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.

units.rawText: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.
units.displayText: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.

spans.text: Ok, nya. Imhotep, signing off.

units.rawText: Well, to be exact, it's not a very interesting reason... It's because she's got those cat-like ears.
units.displayText: Well, to be exact, it's not a very interesting reason... It's because she's got those cat-like ears.

spans.text: Well, to be exact, it's not a very interesting reason... It's because she's got those cat-like ears.

units.rawText: So that's close enough to a catgirl and, by extension, a cat.
units.displayText: So that's close enough to a catgirl and, by extension, a cat.

spans.text: So that's close enough to a catgirl and, by extension, a cat.

units.rawText: She's like a hurt little cat, so she naturally must be a beloved patient of mine~
units.displayText: She's like a hurt little cat, so she naturally must be a beloved patient of mine~

spans.text: She's like a hurt little cat, so she naturally must be a beloved patient of mine~

units.rawText: What sort of Doctor would harass their patient?
units.displayText: What sort of Doctor would harass their patient?

spans.text: What sort of Doctor would harass their patient?

units.rawText: After transferring Imhotep's call to a communications agent on duty, Persicaria purses her lips, patting her cheeks.
units.displayText: After transferring Imhotep's call to a communications agent on duty, Persicaria purses her lips, patting her cheeks.

spans.text: After transferring Imhotep's call to a communications agent on duty, Persicaria purses her lips, patting her cheeks.

units.rawText: Clasping her hands together, she exhaled into them.
units.displayText: Clasping her hands together, she exhaled into them.

spans.text: Clasping her hands together, she exhaled into them.

units.rawText: Hah—calm down. One cannot only look at the problems at hand. As a commandant, more importantly...
units.displayText: Hah—calm down. One cannot only look at the problems at hand. As a commandant, more importantly...

spans.text: Hah—calm down. One cannot only look at the problems at hand. As a commandant, more importantly...

units.rawText: Persicaria processes the information in her neural cloud. The sights before her change in succession, coalescing into scattered parts of a whole, no longer fragments of what was.
units.displayText: Persicaria processes the information in her neural cloud. The sights before her change in succession, coalescing into scattered parts of a whole, no longer fragments of what was.

spans.text: Persicaria processes the information in her neural cloud. The sights before her change in succession, coalescing into scattered parts of a whole, no longer fragments of what was.

units.rawText: Bits and pieces of disparate information fall into place as Persicaria's base level churns, her thoughts picking up on details that went previously unnoticed.
units.displayText: Bits and pieces of disparate information fall into place as Persicaria's base level churns, her thoughts picking up on details that went previously unnoticed.

spans.text: Bits and pieces of disparate information fall into place as Persicaria's base level churns, her thoughts picking up on details that went previously unnoticed.

units.rawText: What the goal of this attack is, whether or not the enemy has a formulated plan... these are not things I need to be considering.
units.displayText: What the goal of this attack is, whether or not the enemy has a formulated plan... these are not things I need to be considering.

spans.text: What the goal of this attack is, whether or not the enemy has a formulated plan... these are not things I need to be considering.

units.rawText: As things are, what I should pay attention to is...
units.displayText: As things are, what I should pay attention to is...

spans.text: As things are, what I should pay attention to is...

units.rawText: Her thoughts and sight drift to the same place, resting on Horizon, her hands still full.
units.displayText: Her thoughts and sight drift to the same place, resting on Horizon, her hands still full.

spans.text: Her thoughts and sight drift to the same place, resting on Horizon, her hands still full.

units.rawText: Horizon!
units.displayText: Horizon!

spans.text: Horizon!

units.rawText: I'm here.
units.displayText: I'm here.

spans.text: I'm here.

units.rawText: Keep the medical and engineering departments, as well as the crisis response center's arrangements, as they are. Move all resource distributions that have not yet started down one level in priority.
units.displayText: Keep the medical and engineering departments, as well as the crisis response center's arrangements, as they are. Move all resource distributions that have not yet started down one level in priority.

spans.text: Keep the medical and engineering departments, as well as the crisis response center's arrangements, as they are. Move all resource distributions that have not yet started down one level in priority.

units.rawText: Place agents coming back online on standby. Establish a defensive exclusionary area and prioritize stopping the ingress of Entropics. Defer to the judgment of those who are on site.
units.displayText: Place agents coming back online on standby. Establish a defensive exclusionary area and prioritize stopping the ingress of Entropics. Defer to the judgment of those who are on site.

spans.text: Place agents coming back online on standby. Establish a defensive exclusionary area and prioritize stopping the ingress of Entropics. Defer to the judgment of those who are on site.

units.rawText: And...
units.displayText: And...

spans.text: And...

units.rawText: Persicaria taps heavily on a spot on the screen.
units.displayText: Persicaria taps heavily on a spot on the screen.

spans.text: Persicaria taps heavily on a spot on the screen.

units.rawText: Zone C and other relevant Zones are composed of many traffic junctions; a complete lockdown is impractical. Allowing the lines to draw longer only increases the odds of small packets of Entropics slipping through the exclusionary zone and is unsustainable.
units.displayText: Zone C and other relevant Zones are composed of many traffic junctions; a complete lockdown is impractical. Allowing the lines to draw longer only increases the odds of small packets of Entropics slipping through the exclusionary zone and is unsustainable.

spans.text: Zone C and other relevant Zones are composed of many traffic junctions; a complete lockdown is impractical. Allowing the lines to draw longer only increases the odds of small packets of Entropics slipping through the exclusionary zone and is unsustainable.

units.rawText: The key to weathering this assault is this gap in the Sandbox Barrier! We cannot give up on Zone G!
units.displayText: The key to weathering this assault is this gap in the Sandbox Barrier! We cannot give up on Zone G!

spans.text: The key to weathering this assault is this gap in the Sandbox Barrier! We cannot give up on Zone G!

units.rawText: No matter how large this gap is, no matter what has already entered Zone G... or even how many Entropics are in the other areas, we need to stem the tide here!
units.displayText: No matter how large this gap is, no matter what has already entered Zone G... or even how many Entropics are in the other areas, we need to stem the tide here!

spans.text: No matter how large this gap is, no matter what has already entered Zone G... or even how many Entropics are in the other areas, we need to stem the tide here!

units.rawText: Are you still going to assist Imhotep?
units.displayText: Are you still going to assist Imhotep?

spans.text: Are you still going to assist Imhotep?

units.rawText: No, I'll have to leave that to you, Horizon.
units.displayText: No, I'll have to leave that to you, Horizon.

spans.text: No, I'll have to leave that to you, Horizon.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: I'll pull some personnel back from the engineering department to form a maintenance team. As for an armed detachment, we can draw some from the guards here.
units.displayText: I'll pull some personnel back from the engineering department to form a maintenance team. As for an armed detachment, we can draw some from the guards here.

spans.text: I'll pull some personnel back from the engineering department to form a maintenance team. As for an armed detachment, we can draw some from the guards here.

units.rawText: I... I understand.
units.displayText: I... I understand.

spans.text: I... I understand.

units.rawText: Looks like you'll have to look for another adjutant, then.
units.displayText: Looks like you'll have to look for another adjutant, then.

spans.text: Looks like you'll have to look for another adjutant, then.

units.rawText: Ops Room to all Exiles, tactical goals established: with no sacrifices as a prerequisite, repair the gap in Zone G!
units.displayText: Ops Room to all Exiles, tactical goals established: with no sacrifices as a prerequisite, repair the gap in Zone G!

spans.text: Ops Room to all Exiles, tactical goals established: with no sacrifices as a prerequisite, repair the gap in Zone G!

units.rawText: The Professor's left the Oasis to me. I can't let it fall like this!
units.displayText: The Professor's left the Oasis to me. I can't let it fall like this!

spans.text: The Professor's left the Oasis to me. I can't let it fall like this!

units.rawText: The great nexus falls into silence for the briefest of moments, and in a flash, it churns with a fierceness once more. Commotion boils and bubbles again—this time, no longer chaotic.
units.displayText: The great nexus falls into silence for the briefest of moments, and in a flash, it churns with a fierceness once more. Commotion boils and bubbles again—this time, no longer chaotic.

spans.text: The great nexus falls into silence for the briefest of moments, and in a flash, it churns with a fierceness once more. Commotion boils and bubbles again—this time, no longer chaotic.

units.rawText: Take them and patch up the gap, or all of this will mean nothing.
units.displayText: Take them and patch up the gap, or all of this will mean nothing.

spans.text: Take them and patch up the gap, or all of this will mean nothing.
